archetypes.name: deployment-risk
archetypes.rationale: The behavior change from 'rerun once regardless' to 'transient-only rerun' has operational impact on design-log publish reliability; the bash stderr redirection to DESIGN_TMPDIR also carries silent-failure risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the behavioral change in run_design_log_ci_merge (python/design_log_ship.py): the new guard returns ok=False for non-transient failures without attempting any rerun. Evaluate whether this policy could cause design-log publish failures in cases where a single unconditional rerun would have succeeded (e.g., flaky non-network CI failures that aren't caught by the transient signature check). Examine the bash change in scripts/design-log-publish.sh where stderr is redirected to `${DESIGN_TMPDIR}/design-log-ship.stderr.log` under `set +e`; assess what happens when DESIGN_TMPDIR is unset or empty (the variable expands to `/design-log-ship.stderr.log`), whether a failed redirect silently suppresses stderr, and whether any error path loses diagnostic output as a result. Check whether the DesignLogMergeResult detail strings emitted when the new guard fires give operators enough information to distinguish a deterministic CI failure from a transient one whose logs weren't ready in time. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
